rationale_md:
The panel's equal-weight mean is 0.65 (n=8), which supports the current High rating. Proposed: High.

Answers range 0.30-0.85 (IQR 0.28). The weighted mean is 0.67, shown as a secondary number only.

Disagreement, kept in: Two experts put the chance below the panel mean; their notes are about access and conflict.

Disagreement, kept in: One expert puts the chance above the panel mean; the subject of their note is not summarised here, because in a panel of eight it would name them.

Raised by 2: Night-time militia movement near Adre is not in any public reporting yet. (single-source).

Raised by 2: Camp capacity in Ouaddai is already past what the sites were planned for. (corroborated).

Raised by 1: held in the verification queue (one expert) (not checked).

Expansion of cross-border attacks and insecurity - 40% complete puts the trigger 'Expansion of cross-border attacks and insecurity' at 40% complete. (https://reliefweb.int/report/chad/unfpa-situation-report-chad-humanitarian-response-1-30-april-2026)

Attacks on strategic infrastructure in Chad - 10% complete puts the trigger 'Attacks on strategic infrastructure in Chad' at 10% complete. (https://issafrica.org/iss-today/urgent-au-action-could-defuse-rising-chad-sudan-tensions)

Renewed proxy mobilisation and cross-border armed group activity - 20% complete puts the trigger 'Renewed proxy mobilisation and cross-border armed group activity' at 20% complete. (https://issafrica.org/iss-today/urgent-au-action-could-defuse-rising-chad-sudan-tensions)

Integrity note (shared_origin): Two 'what are we missing' entries may share an origin (near-identical wording).

Surprisingly-popular (experimental): yes. Actual share above 0.5 0.6667 against a predicted 0.6417.

Probability band to number is an assumption of this build, not an ACAPS mapping: {'Very Low': 0.05, 'Low': 0.25, 'Medium': 0.5, 'High': 0.75, 'Very High': 0.95}.
